caption:
South Korean banks' net profit rises 2.1% to 21.5 trillion won

Net profit of 20 banks rose 500 billion won from 21 trillion won a year earlier on higher interest income. That is up 500 billion won from 21 trillion won a year earlier, driven by a rise in interest income, according to Financial Supervisory Service data. Source: The Korea Herald

Reported by The Korea Herald.
